Class StringUtilsTest

@IsTest
public class StringUtilsTest

Test class for StringUtils. Validates string manipulation, email validation, ID validation, and string splitting functionality. Ensures all utility methods work correctly across various input scenarios and edge cases.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void getBlankValueTest()

Tests the getBlankValue() method with blank and non-blank input values. Verifies that the method returns the default value when the input is null or empty, and returns the input value when it is not blank.

@IsTest
private static void getNextCharTest()

Tests the getNextChar() method with alphabetic and numeric characters. Verifies that the method correctly returns the next character in the sequence, and wraps around from Z to A and 9 to 0.

@IsTest
private static void isNotValidEmailTest()

Tests the isNotValidEmail() method with various invalid email addresses. Verifies that the method correctly identifies malformed email addresses including missing domain extensions, missing @ symbols, double dots, and multiple @ symbols.

@IsTest
private static void isValidIdTest()

Tests the isValidId() method with valid and invalid Salesforce IDs. Verifies that the method correctly identifies valid 15-character and 18-character IDs, and rejects IDs with incorrect lengths.

@IsTest
private static void splitTest()

Tests the split() method with a string containing multiple delimiters. Verifies that the method correctly splits strings by comma, semicolon, pipe, and line feeds, and trims whitespace from the resulting values.
